title: hiraea gaudichaudiana
intro: Hiraea gaudichaudiana, commonly known as the Pink Pouto or Pouto Tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Malpighiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in New Zealand for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to soothe skin irritations and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Hiraea gaudichaudiana include its ability to act as a vulnerary, astringent, and diuretic, making it useful for wound healing, skin conditions, and urinary issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
